name: court-scale-manifest-training-smoke
command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
TASK_ROOT=/home/kamimura/projects/tennis-lab/.claude/worktrees/court-scale-training-eval
ASSET_ROOT=/home/kamimura/projects/tennis-lab
cd "$TASK_ROOT"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
.venv/bin/python -m src.tasks.court_detection.scripts.train --config-name train_data_scaling \
  "paths.data_root=$ASSET_ROOT" \
  "paths.checkpoint_root=$ASSET_ROOT/ckpt" "paths.external_asset_root=$ASSET_ROOT/third_party" \
  "paths.output_root=$TASK_ROOT/tmp/court-scale-manifest-smoke/outputs" \
  "paths.artifact_root=$TASK_ROOT/tmp/court-scale-manifest-smoke/outputs" \
  data.source.manifest=.claude/worktrees/court-scale-trajectory-strategies/tmp/court-scale-review/run-04/1bef5ceda3d453b269cbb99e6b0d422e1e8466ad4e89d527cfa12b67d361dcda.dataset.json \
  mixed.sources.tennis_court_detector.root=.claude/worktrees/court-scale-training-eval/tmp/court-scale/smoke-data/real \
  mixed.sources.tennis_court_detector.registry=court_detection/evaluate/smoke-real-video-v1/s42/registry.json \
  data.batch_size=1 mixed.train_batch_counts.synthetic_court=1 data.num_workers=0 \
  training.compile.enabled=false training.trainer.enable_progress_bar=false training.trainer.enable_model_summary=false \
  training.trainer.log_every_n_steps=1 training.warmup_steps=1 training.step_schedule.max_steps=3 \
  training.step_schedule.validation_every_n_steps=3 training.step_schedule.checkpoint_every_n_steps=3 \
  run.output_dir=court_detection/train/dataset-version-smoke/s42
CKPT="$TASK_ROOT/tmp/court-scale-manifest-smoke/outputs/court_detection/train/dataset-version-smoke/s42/logs/version_0/checkpoints/update-00000003.ckpt"
.venv/bin/python -m src.tasks.court_detection.scripts.evaluate_ablation \
  --checkpoint "$CKPT" --expected-step 3 --split val --series smoke \
  --output "$TASK_ROOT/tmp/court-scale-manifest-smoke/outputs/court_detection/evaluate/dataset-version-smoke-val/s42"
